title: Dark Chat
emptyHint: Start one, or join with a code somebody gave you.
aliasHint: What this channel sees you as. Nothing else about you is shown.
codeHint: Eight letters and digits, from somebody already in the channel.
codeOnce: Share this code with the people you want in. Anyone who has it can join.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Note the code down instead.
noMessagesHint: Say something. It will not stay forever.
rotateMessage: The old code stops working. Everyone already in stays in.
removeMessage: They leave the channel and can never rejoin it.
leaveMessage: It disappears from your list. Getting back in takes a code.
